title: Automatic reminders say on but the owner cannot see who will get them
what: The automatic reminders page shows only how many reminder types are switched on. The reminders are set by each member's own phone, so a member without the app, with notifications blocked, or with no birthday saved silently gets nothing. The page never says how many members each reminder can reach or who is missed and why.
expected: Next to each reminder: how many members it can reach, and a list of who will not get it with the reason (no app, no birthday saved, notifications off).
how_often: every time; the phone side (notifications allowed, phone maker battery rules) cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Show reach per reminder and the missed members with the reason

title: No record that an automatic reminder went to a member
what: Automatic reminders are scheduled on each member's phone, with no server sending. Nothing comes back to the gym, so the owner (and HQ) cannot open any record that says a plan-ending or birthday reminder reached a member, when, or why not.
expected: A simple record per reminder (sent, to whom, when) or at least a per-member line saying the phone has the reminders set.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Let the phone report back when it sets or shows a reminder, and show that to the owner

title: Manual WhatsApp lists do not know the automatic reminder already went
what: The ready-made WhatsApp lists Plan ending, Plan ended, Birthday wish and Haven't seen you pick members only by date. The same members with the app already get the matching automatic reminder on their phone, so they get the same message twice, and the screen never says so.
expected: The list marks or leaves out members who already get the automatic reminder, or says plainly that app members already get it.
fix_line: Mark app members who already get the automatic one on the WhatsApp list

title: A pasted amount with paise or commas becomes a much bigger number
what: In the message maker the amount and discount boxes throw away every non-digit. Pasting 1,500.50 gives 150050, and 12.5 percent becomes 125 percent. The wrong figure then goes out in the message to members.
expected: Commas are dropped, but a decimal point stops the number (or is refused with a short note), and a percent above 100 is refused.
how_often: whenever an amount with paise or a decimal discount is typed or pasted
fix_line: Cut the number at the decimal point and cap percent at 100

title: Instant alerts that never went out are not shown to the owner
what: When the owner picks instant alerts, an alert that waited more than 6 hours (sending job stopped) is marked late and never sent, and one with no browser to send to is marked none. Both are kept only on the server. Only the test alert tells the owner it did not arrive; real alerts that never went show no sign anywhere in the panel.
expected: The bell or the alert settings show when real alerts could not be sent and why.
how_often: whenever the sending job stops or no browser is set up
fix_line: Show a line when recent alerts were not pushed, with the reason

title: On iPhone nobody is told when rest alerts cannot sound
what: The row that warns a member that rest alerts are off, silent or may be late shows only on Android. On iPhone it never shows, so a member who blocked notifications gets no rest alert and no warning. On Android, if the phone cannot be asked, the row also stays hidden.
expected: iPhone shows the same warning row when notifications are blocked, and a phone that cannot be asked says it could not check.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: on an iPhone with MettleUp notifications turned off, finish a set and see if any rest alert or warning appears
fix_line: Read the iPhone notification permission and show the same warning row

title: iPhone What's new lists Android and Wear OS features
what: Settings, What's new shows the same update list on every phone. iPhone members read lines such as 'Have a Wear OS watch? tap Install on watch' and watch screen and watch update notes, which do not exist on iPhone. The new-feature dots already skip these on iPhone, but the written list does not.
expected: Lines for features that do not exist on iPhone are left out of the iPhone list.
how_often: every time an iPhone member opens What's new
fix_line: Mark Android-only and watch lines and hide them on iPhone

title: iPhone members are never told a new version exists
what: The update check returns nothing on iPhone until an App Store check is built, so an iPhone member on an old version never sees an update notice, while Android members do.
expected: iPhone members get a notice when a newer version is out, or the gap is written down as a known iPhone limit.
fix_line: Add the App Store version check for iPhone

title: The Alerts off hint during rest never shows on iPhone
what: When a rest starts, the phone checks whether alerts can sound and shows 'Alerts off, your phone won't buzz when rest is over'. The check runs only on Android, so an iPhone member with notifications blocked rests with no alert and no hint.
expected: iPhone shows the same hint when its notifications are blocked.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: on an iPhone with notifications off, start a rest and look under the timer bar
fix_line: Run the same check on iPhone using its notification permission

title: A failed record update after logging a past workout leaves no trace
what: After a past workout is saved, the personal records of later workouts are worked out again. If that step fails, the failure is swallowed with no log line, and only a flag is kept. Nothing in this area reads that flag, so the member is not told their records list may be out of date, and no log helps find out why.
expected: The failure is logged, and the member sees a short note that records will catch up (or a retry runs).
proof: code-read (screens outside this folder were not searched for a reader of the flag)
how_often: rare, only when the record rebuild fails
fix_line: Log the error and show or retry when the flag is false
